action_zones.rationale: First-run zones: Buy Below uses the 52-week low as the only available downside anchor. Fair value center is $446.78, averaging current implied forward-earnings value from price/Forward P/E and the Finviz analyst target; high beta widens the hold band.

notes: Sharp pullback leaves AVGO below 20/50-day averages but still above the 200-day, with valuation inexpensive on forward P/E versus growth.
